newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bourses to concentrate trade in one building.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bourses to concentrate trade in one building.

text.p: The Amsterdam Exchanges (AEX) said on Wednesday it would concentrate all trading of securities and options in the building of the Amsterdam Stock Exchange.

All trading of the AEX Options Exchange will be moved to the present trading floor of the stock exchange. Stock and bond traders will be moved to a new trading floor on the second level of that building.

The AEX said the lack of space in the options exchange's present building made a quick decision necessary. The move is expected to take place in the autumn of 1998 and is seen as a solution for the next five to eight years, it said.
